plain: Not fitting together; clashing, so that both cannot be true

example.quote: To give them cognizance in disputes between a state and the citizens thereof, is utterly inconsistent with reason or good policy.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 18, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
